contract: Resumable-match summary (client/src/hooks/useResumables.ts): opponentCount must equal the number of live opponents of the local human (seat 0). The shipped formula `liveCount = players.filter(p => !p.is_eliminated).length; opponentCount = Math.max(0, liveCount - 1)` assumes seat 0 is always alive. Discriminating case from the issue: players [{id:0, eliminated}, {id:1, live}, {id:2, live}] must report 2 opponents, not 1. Tested by evaluating the exact shipped expressions (extracted verbatim from the mainline source file) against fixtures — no re-implementation of the logic.
